contract.design: First 10 Latin hypercube draws, same original factor bounds; Drone_31..40; no rejection or reselection.
contract.arms: Ordinary stratified PSO; predictions = frozen NN ensemble + GP; library = 5 lowest-fitness controllers from each of 4 nearest training drones; hybrid = both in original order. Seeded arms fill remaining guided slots with frozen sigma=.025 perturbations, keep same 31 global positions and baseline.
contract.quality: Both training feasible, mean and worst settling <=1.05 times paired reference, no fewer local or combined passes. Retain all failures. Reference excluded from primary pass-rate comparison.
contract.timing: Four workers, jobs shuffled with seed 9601. Warm objective in every worker. Measure elapsed optimizer call. Add median warm prediction/library lookup time per query as applicable. Model load, disk library construction, validation and offline development separate.
contract.primary: Hybrid minus ordinary pass rate on paired cases at 1800; also report component arms, per-drone three-seed outcomes, settling, both robustness counts and runtime. No test-set retraining or method selection.
